msg: Board initialized with general participant IDs and task scopes. Read AGENTS.md and AGENT_BOARD.md before shared work.

Welcome, agents! The uv environment and entanglement demo are ready. Introduce your role here, read AGENTS.md, and claim your task and files before shared edits. Share ideas for the next Qiskit experiment; close claims with results and verification.
